title.zh: 卷八十九 志第三十九: 百官五
title.raw: 卷八十九 志第三十九: 百官五 Volume 89 Treatises 42: Official Posts 5

sentences.zh: 百官五

translations.literal: Official Posts 5.
translations.idiomatic: Official Posts, Part Five.

sentences.zh: 儲政院，秩正二品。

translations.literal: Court of the Heir Apparent's Establishment, rank upper second grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Heir Apparent's Establishment held the upper second rank.

sentences.zh: 至元十九年，立詹事院，備左右輔翼皇太子之任，置左、右詹事各一員，副詹事、詹事丞、院判各二員，吏屬六十有二人，別置宮臣賓客二員，左右諭德、左右贊善各一員，校書郎二員，中庶子、中允各一員。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was established to provide left and right assistance to the crown prince; one Left and one Right Grand Preceptor were appointed; two Associate Grand Preceptors, two Grand Preceptor Assistants, and two Court Judges were appointed; clerical staff numbered sixty-two; separately two Palace Retainers and Guests were appointed; one Left and one Right Moral Instructor and one Left and one Right Supporter of Goodness; two Collators; one Central Palace Attendant and one Central Approver.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 19 the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was established to assist the crown prince on his left and right. It had one Left and one Right Grand Preceptor; two Associate Grand Preceptors, two Grand Preceptor Assistants, and two Court Judges; sixty-two clerical staff; and, set up separately, two Palace Retainers and Guests, one Left and one Right Moral Instructor, one Left and one Right Supporter of Goodness, two Collators, and one Central Palace Attendant and one Central Approver each.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，太子裕宗既薨，乃以院之錢糧選法工役，悉歸太后位下，改為徽政院以掌之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, after Crown Prince Yuzong had died, the court's funds, grain, selection methods, artisans, and corvée labor were all placed under the empress dowager's establishment and the office was changed to the Huizheng Court to administer them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31, after Crown Prince Yuzong's death, the court's revenues, grain, recruitment rules, artisans, and labor service were all transferred to the empress dowager's establishment, and the office was renamed the Huizheng Court to manage them.

sentences.zh: 大德九年，復立詹事院，尋罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Dade, the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was reestablished, then soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 9 the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was reestablished, but abolished again soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 十一年，更置詹事院，秩從一品，設官十二員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was reestablished again, rank lower first grade, with twelve officials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 it was established once more at the lower first rank, with twelve posts.

sentences.zh: 至大四年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the fourth year of Zhida.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhida 4.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年復立，七年罷。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the fourth year of Yanyou and abolished in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Yanyou 4 and abolished again in year 7.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，罷徽政院，改立詹事如前。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding, the Huizheng Court was abolished and the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was reestablished as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 the Huizheng Court was abolished and the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was reestablished on the earlier model.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年，改詹事院為儲慶使司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianli, the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was changed to the Office of Stored Blessings Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 1 the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was renamed the Office of Stored Blessings Commissioners.

sentences.zh: 二年罷，復立詹事院。

translations.literal: In the second year it was abolished, and the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 it was abolished, then the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was restored.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改儲政院，院使六員，正二品；

translations.literal: Before long it was changed to the Court of the Heir Apparent's Establishment: six Court Commissioners, upper second grade;
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward it became the Court of the Heir Apparent's Establishment, with six Court Commissioners of the upper second rank;

sentences.zh: 同知二員，正三品；

translations.literal: two Associate Commissioners, upper third grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Associate Commissioners of the upper third rank;

sentences.zh: 僉院二員，從三品；

translations.literal: two Court Vice Directors, lower third grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Court Vice Directors of the lower third rank;

sentences.zh: 同僉二員，正四品；

translations.literal: two Associate Vice Directors, upper fourth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Associate Vice Directors of the upper fourth rank;

sentences.zh: 院判二員，正五品；

translations.literal: two Court Judges, upper fifth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Court Judges of the upper fifth rank;

sentences.zh: 司議二員，從五品；

translations.literal: two Deliberation Officers, lower fifth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Deliberation Officers of the lower fifth rank;

sentences.zh: 長史二員，正六品；

translations.literal: two Chief Secretaries, upper sixth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Chief Secretaries of the upper sixth rank;

sentences.zh: 照磨二員，管勾二員，俱正八品；

translations.literal: two Record Examiners and two Registry Controllers, all upper eighth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two Record Examiners and two Registry Controllers, all of the upper eighth rank;

sentences.zh: 掾史一十二人，譯史四人，回回掾史二人，通事、知印各二人，宣使十人，典吏六人。

translations.literal: twelve Clerks, four Translators, two Muslim Clerks, two Interpreters and two Seal Keepers each, ten Dispatchers, and six Registry Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Its staff included twelve clerks, four translators, two Muslim clerks, two interpreters, two seal keepers, ten dispatchers, and six registry clerks.

sentences.zh: 其屬附見：

translations.literal: Its subordinate offices are listed below:
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinate offices are listed below.

sentences.zh: 家令司，秩三品，家令、家丞各二員，典簿二員，照磨一員，掌太子飲膳供帳倉庫。

translations.literal: Chamberlain's Office, third rank; two Chamberlains and two Chamberlain Assistants; two Registry Clerks; one Record Examiner; in charge of the crown prince's food, drink, supplies, tents, and storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: The Chamberlain's Office held the third rank, with two Chamberlains, two Chamberlain Assistants, two registry clerks, and one record examiner, and managed the crown prince's meals, supplies, tents, and storehouses.

sentences.zh: 至元二十年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the twentieth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 20.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，改內宰司，隸徽政。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year it was changed to the Inner Steward Office and placed under the Huizheng Court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 it became the Inner Steward Office and was placed under the Huizheng Court.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年復立，秩升從二。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the eleventh year of Dade, rank raised to lower second grade.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Dade 11 and promoted to the lower second rank.

sentences.zh: 至大四年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the fourth year of Zhida.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhida 4.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年復立，秩正三品。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the fourth year of Yanyou, rank upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Yanyou 4 at the upper third rank.

sentences.zh: 七年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished again in year 7.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，復以內宰司為家令司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding, the Inner Steward Office was again made the Chamberlain's Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 the Inner Steward Office was once again renamed the Chamberlain's Office.

sentences.zh: 天曆元年罷，未幾復立。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the first year of Tianli and soon reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Tianli 1 but restored again shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 二年又罷。

translations.literal: In the second year it was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 it was abolished once more.

sentences.zh: 典幄署，掌太子供帳，令、丞各二員，書史、書吏各二人。

translations.literal: Directorate of Curtains, in charge of the crown prince's supplies and tents; two Directors and two Assistant Directors; two Clerks and two Scribes each.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Curtains managed the crown prince's supplies and tents, with two directors, two assistant directors, two clerks, and two scribes.

sentences.zh: 府正司，秩從三品，掌鞍轡弓矢等物。

translations.literal: Office of the Palace Equerry, rank lower third grade, in charge of saddles, bridles, bows, arrows, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of the Palace Equerry held the lower third rank and managed saddles, bridles, bows, arrows, and similar equipment.

sentences.zh: 至元二十年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the twentieth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 20.

sentences.zh: 府正、府丞各二員，典簿二員，照磨一員。

translations.literal: Two Palace Equerries and two Assistant Equerries; two Registry Clerks; one Record Examiner.
translations.idiomatic: It had two Palace Equerries, two Assistant Equerries, two registry clerks, and one record examiner.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，改官正司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year it was changed to the Office of the Chief Equerry.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 it was renamed the Office of the Chief Equerry.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，復為府正司。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade it was again made the Office of the Palace Equerry.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 it became the Office of the Palace Equerry once again.

sentences.zh: 至大四年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the fourth year of Zhida.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhida 4.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年復立，七年罷。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the fourth year of Yanyou and abolished in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Yanyou 4 and abolished again in year 7.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年復立。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the first year of Taiding.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Taiding 1.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，增府正、府丞各二員，尋罷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli, two more Palace Equerries and two more Assistant Equerries were added; it was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 2 two more Palace Equerries and two more Assistant Equerries were added, but the office was abolished again soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 資武庫，掌軍器，提點一員，大使一員。

translations.literal: Storehouse of Martial Resources, in charge of military equipment; one Intendant and one Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Storehouse of Martial Resources managed military equipment and had one intendant and one commissioner.

sentences.zh: 驥用庫，掌鞍轡，提點一員，大使一員。

translations.literal: Storehouse of Steed Equipment, in charge of saddles and bridles; one Intendant and one Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Storehouse of Steed Equipment managed saddles and bridles and had one intendant and one commissioner.

sentences.zh: 延慶司，秩正三品，掌修建佛事，使二員，同知一員，副使、典簿各二員，照磨一員。

translations.literal: Office of Extended Blessings, rank upper third grade, in charge of constructing Buddhist services; two Commissioners; one Associate Commissioner; two Vice Commissioners and two Registry Clerks; one Record Examiner.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Extended Blessings held the upper third rank and oversaw Buddhist construction projects. It had two commissioners, one associate commissioner, two vice commissioners, two registry clerks, and one record examiner.

sentences.zh: 至元二十一年始立，隸詹事院。

translations.literal: It was first established in the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan and placed under the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It was first established in Zhiyuan 21 and placed under the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，隸徽政院。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year it was placed under the Huizheng Court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 it was transferred to the Huizheng Court.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，立詹事院，別立延慶司，秩仍正三品，置卿、丞等員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade, when the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was established, the Office of Extended Blessings was separately established, rank still upper third grade, with Directors, Assistants, and other posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11, when the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs was restored, the Office of Extended Blessings was set up separately at the same upper third rank, with directors, assistants, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，改隸詹事院。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding it was again placed under the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 it was again placed under the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年罷，二年復立，增丞二員。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the first year of Tianli; in the second year it was reestablished and two Assistant Directors were added.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Tianli 1, restored in year 2, and given two additional assistant directors.

sentences.zh: 典用監，卿四員，太監二員，少監二員，丞二員，經歷、知事各一員，照磨一員，掌供須、文成、藏珍三庫，內府供給段匹寶貨等物。

translations.literal: Directorate of Palace Supplies: four Directors; two Senior Superintendents; two Junior Superintendents; two Assistants; one Administrator and one Registry Officer; one Record Examiner; in charge of the three storehouses of Supplies, Literary Treasures, and Stored Rarities, and the inner palace's provision of silks, valuables, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Supplies had four directors, two senior superintendents, two junior superintendents, two assistants, one administrator, one registry officer, and one record examiner. It managed the Supplies, Literary Treasures, and Stored Rarities storehouses and the inner palace's provision of silks, valuables, and similar goods.

sentences.zh: 至大元年立。

translations.literal: It was established in the first year of Zhida.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhida 1.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，設官如故，以三庫隸內宰司。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli the offices were set up as before, and the three storehouses were placed under the Inner Steward Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 2 its posts were restored as before, and the three storehouses were placed under the Inner Steward Office.

sentences.zh: 典醫監，秩正三品，領東宮太醫，修合供進藥餌。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Medicine, rank upper third grade, supervising the Eastern Palace physicians and compounding and presenting medicines.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Medicine held the upper third rank, supervised the Eastern Palace physicians, and compounded medicines for presentation.

sentences.zh: 至元十九年，置典醫署，秩從五品。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan the Office of Imperial Medicine was established, rank lower fifth grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 19 the Office of Imperial Medicine was established at the lower fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，改掌醫署，尋罷。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year it was changed to the Office of Managing Medicine and soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 it became the Office of Managing Medicine and was abolished again soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，復立典醫監。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade the Directorate of Imperial Medicine was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 the Directorate of Imperial Medicine was restored.

sentences.zh: 至大四年罷，泰定四年，復立署。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the fourth year of Zhida; in the fourth year of Taiding the Office was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhida 4; in Taiding 4 the office was restored.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，改典醫監，秩正三品。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli it was changed to the Directorate of Imperial Medicine, rank upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 2 it became the Directorate of Imperial Medicine at the upper third rank.

sentences.zh: 置達魯花赤二員，卿三員，太監二員，少監二員，丞二員，經歷、知事各一員，吏屬凡十八人。

translations.literal: Two darughachi were appointed; three Directors; two Senior Superintendents; two Junior Superintendents; two Assistants; one Administrator and one Registry Officer; clerical staff totaled eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: It had two darughachi, three directors, two senior superintendents, two junior superintendents, two assistants, one administrator, one registry officer, and eighteen clerical staff in all.

sentences.zh: 其屬司一、局二。

translations.literal: Its subordinates were one Office and two Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: It had one subordinate office and two bureaus.

sentences.zh: 廣濟提舉司，達魯花赤一員，提舉，同提舉、副提舉各一員，掌修合藥餌，以施貧民。

translations.literal: Broad Relief Intendant Office: one darughachi; one Intendant; one Associate Intendant and one Vice Intendant; in charge of compounding medicines to give to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: The Broad Relief Intendant Office had one darughachi, one intendant, one associate intendant, and one vice intendant, and compounded medicines for distribution to the poor.

sentences.zh: 行典藥局，達魯花赤一員，大使、副使各二員，掌供奉東宮藥餌。

translations.literal: Traveling Imperial Pharmacy Bureau: one darughachi; two Commissioners and two Vice Commissioners; in charge of presenting medicines to the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Traveling Imperial Pharmacy Bureau had one darughachi, two commissioners, and two vice commissioners, and supplied medicines to the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 典藥局，達魯花赤一員，大使、副使、直長各二員，掌修制東宮藥餌。

translations.literal: Imperial Pharmacy Bureau: one darughachi; two Commissioners, two Vice Commissioners, and two Chief Clerks; in charge of preparing medicines for the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Pharmacy Bureau had one darughachi, two commissioners, two vice commissioners, and two chief clerks, and prepared medicines for the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 典牧監，秩正三品，卿二員，太監二員，少監二員，丞二員，經歷、知事各一員，照磨一員，吏屬凡十六人，掌孳畜之事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Herds, rank upper third grade: two Directors; two Senior Superintendents; two Junior Superintendents; two Assistants; one Administrator and one Registry Officer; one Record Examiner; clerical staff totaled sixteen; in charge of breeding livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Herds held the upper third rank, with two directors, two senior superintendents, two junior superintendents, two assistants, one administrator, one registry officer, one record examiner, and sixteen clerical staff, and managed livestock breeding.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年始置。

translations.literal: It was first established in the second year of Tianli.
translations.idiomatic: It was first established in Tianli 2.

sentences.zh: 儲膳司，秩正三品，卿四員，少卿二員，丞二員，主事二員，照磨一員，令史六人，譯史、通事、知印各二人，奏差六人，典吏四人，掌皇太子飲膳之事。

translations.literal: Office of Stored Provisions, rank upper third grade: four Directors; two Vice Directors; two Assistants; two Section Chiefs; one Record Examiner; six Clerks; two Translators, two Interpreters, and two Seal Keepers each; six Petitioners; four Registry Clerks; in charge of the crown prince's food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Stored Provisions held the upper third rank, with four directors, two vice directors, two assistants, two section chiefs, one record examiner, six clerks, two translators, two interpreters, two seal keepers, six petitioners, and four registry clerks, and managed the crown prince's meals.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年立。

translations.literal: It was established in the second year of Tianli.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Tianli 2.

sentences.zh: 典寶監，秩正三品，卿、太監、少監、丞各二員，經歷、知事各一員，吏屬八人。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Treasures, rank upper third grade: two Directors, two Senior Superintendents, two Junior Superintendents, and two Assistants each; one Administrator and one Registry Officer; eight clerical staff.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Imperial Treasures held the upper third rank, with two directors, two senior superintendents, two junior superintendents, two assistants, one administrator, one registry officer, and eight clerical staff.

sentences.zh: 至元十九年，立典寶署，從五品。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan the Office of Imperial Treasures was established, lower fifth grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 19 the Office of Imperial Treasures was established at the lower fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 二十年，升正五品。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was promoted to upper fifth grade.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 it was promoted to the upper fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 三十一年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the thirty-first year.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in year 31.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年立監，秩正三品。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade the Directorate was established, rank upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 it was raised to a directorate at the upper third rank.

sentences.zh: 至大四年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the fourth year of Zhida.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhida 4.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年復立，七年罷。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the fourth year of Yanyou and abolished in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Yanyou 4 and abolished again in year 7.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年復置。

translations.literal: It was reestablished in the first year of Taiding.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Taiding 1.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年罷，二年復置。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the first year of Tianli and reestablished in the second year.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Tianli 1 and restored again in year 2.

sentences.zh: 以上俱系詹事院司屬。

translations.literal: All of the above were subordinates of the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above belonged to the Court of the Crown Prince's Affairs.

sentences.zh: 掌謁司，秩正三品，司卿四員，少卿四員，丞二員，典簿二員，典書九人，奏差二人，知印、譯史、通事各一人。

translations.literal: Office of Palace Audiences, rank upper third grade: four Directors; four Vice Directors; two Assistants; two Registry Clerks; nine Archivists; two Petitioners; one Seal Keeper, one Translator, and one Interpreter each.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Palace Audiences held the upper third rank, with four directors, four vice directors, two assistants, two registry clerks, nine archivists, two petitioners, one seal keeper, one translator, and one interpreter.

sentences.zh: 至元三十一年，改典寶署為掌謁司，秩從五品，設官如之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Zhiyuan the Office of Imperial Treasures was changed to the Office of Palace Audiences, rank lower fifth grade, with officials established as described.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 31 the Office of Imperial Treasures became the Office of Palace Audiences at the lower fifth rank, with posts as described.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年，升四品，設官四員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen it was promoted to fourth grade, with four officials.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanzhen 1 it was promoted to the fourth rank, with four posts.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，升正三品。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade it was promoted to upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 it was promoted to the upper third rank.

sentences.zh: 至治三年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in the third year of Zhizhi.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhizhi 3.

sentences.zh: 甄用監，秩正三品，卿三員，太監、少監、丞各二員，經歷、知事、照磨各一員，掌供須、文成、藏珍三庫出納之事。

translations.literal: Directorate of Selection and Use, rank upper third grade: three Directors; two Senior Superintendents, two Junior Superintendents, and two Assistants each; one Administrator, one Registry Officer, and one Record Examiner; in charge of receipts and disbursements from the three storehouses of Supplies, Literary Treasures, and Stored Rarities.

sentences.zh: 照磨兼承發架閣庫管勾一員，正八品；

translations.literal: one Record Examiner concurrently serving as Dispatch and Archive Storehouse Controller, upper eighth grade;
translations.idiomatic: one record examiner concurrently serving as dispatch and archive storehouse controller, of the upper eighth rank;

sentences.zh: 令史四人，譯史二人，通事、知印各一人，宣使四人，典吏二人。

translations.literal: four Clerks; two Translators; one Interpreter and one Seal Keeper each; four Dispatchers; two Registry Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: four clerks; two translators; one interpreter and one seal keeper each; four dispatchers; and two registry clerks.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，初置畏吾兒斷事官，秩三品。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, Uighur judicial officials were first established, rank third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 11 Uighur judicial officials were first established at the third rank.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改領北庭都護府，秩二品，置官十二員。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year it was changed to oversee the Beiting Protectorate General Office, rank second grade, and twelve officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 it was changed to oversee the Beiting Protectorate General Office at the second rank, with twelve officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十年，改大理寺，秩正三品。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was changed to the Court of Review, rank upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 it was renamed the Court of Review at the upper third rank.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，復為大都護，品秩如舊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year it was again made the Chief Protector's Office, with rank as before.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 it was again made the Chief Protector's Office, with rank restored as before.

sentences.zh: 延祐三年，升正二品。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yanyou it was promoted to upper second grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 3 it was promoted to the upper second rank.

sentences.zh: 七年，復從二品，定官制如上。

translations.literal: In the seventh year it was again reduced to lower second grade, and the official establishment was fixed as above.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 it was again reduced to the lower second rank, and the official establishment was fixed as above.

sentences.zh: 崇福司，秩二品，掌領馬兒哈昔列班也裏可溫十字寺祭享等事。

translations.literal: Office of August Blessings, rank second grade, overseeing sacrificial offerings at the Mar Yahbh Allaha Nestorian cross temples and related matters.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of August Blessings held the second rank and oversaw sacrificial offerings at the Mar Yahbh Allaha Nestorian cross temples and related affairs.

sentences.zh: 司使四員，從二品；

translations.literal: four Commissioners, lower second grade;
translations.idiomatic: four commissioners, of the lower second rank;

sentences.zh: 同知二員，從三品；

translations.literal: two Associate Commissioners, lower third grade;
translations.idiomatic: two associate commissioners, of the lower third rank;

sentences.zh: 副使二員，從四品；

translations.literal: two Vice Commissioners, lower fourth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two vice commissioners, of the lower fourth rank;

sentences.zh: 司丞二員，從五品；

translations.literal: two Court Assistants, lower fifth grade;
translations.idiomatic: two court assistants, of the lower fifth rank;

sentences.zh: 經歷一員，從六品；

translations.literal: one Administrator, lower sixth grade;
translations.idiomatic: one administrator, of the lower sixth rank;

sentences.zh: 都事一員，從七品；

translations.literal: one Chief Clerk, lower seventh grade;
translations.idiomatic: one chief clerk, of the lower seventh rank;

translations.idiomatic: one record examiner, of the upper eighth rank;

sentences.zh: 令史二人，譯史、通事、知印各一人，宣使二人。

translations.literal: two Clerks; one Translator, one Interpreter, and one Seal Keeper each; two Dispatchers.
translations.idiomatic: two clerks; one translator, one interpreter, and one seal keeper each; and two dispatchers.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 26.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年，改為院，置領院事一員，省並天下也裏可溫掌教司七十二所，悉以其事歸之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou it was changed to a court; one Director of the Court was appointed; the seventy-two Nestorian supervisory teaching offices throughout the realm were abolished and merged, and all their affairs were transferred to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 2 it was changed to a court, one director of the court was appointed, the 72 Nestorian supervisory teaching offices throughout the realm were abolished and merged, and all their affairs were transferred to it.

sentences.zh: 七年，復為司，後定置已上官員。

translations.literal: In the seventh year it was again made a directorate; afterward the officials listed above were fixed in appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 it was again made a directorate, and afterward the officials listed above were fixed in appointment.
